The bird observations shown here come from my personal [eBird](https://ebird.org/home){target="_blank"} account. Observations are recorded via the [Merlin Bird ID](https://www.merlinbirds.org/){target="_blank"} phone app. The links embedded in the **Name** column point to the corresponding species' page on eBird, while the map shows the geographic location where the species was spotted.

For a step-by-step summary of how this file was made, see my [Working with eBird Data](https://marknepf.github.io/code/r_vignettes/nepf_ebird.html){target="_blank"} vignette.

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, eval = FALSE}

# install
install.packages("tidyverse")  # cleaning data
install.packages("janitor")  # cleaning data
install.packages("rebird")  # REBIRD
install.packages("leaflet")  # interactive map
install.packages("gt")  # creating tables

```

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

# load
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(rebird)
library(leaflet)
library(gt)

```

### Interactive Map

Click on a bird below to see who's there!

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}


# eBird taxonomy
taxonomy <- ebirdtaxonomy()

# my eBirds
birds <- read.csv("MyEBirdData.csv") |>
  clean_names() |>
  
  mutate(spot_date = as.Date(date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) |>

  filter(
    
    # remove identifiable locations
    !location %in% c("Rugglebug Clubhouse", "Ben", "Home"),
    
    # remove unclear species
    !common_name %in% c("Larus sp.", "passerine sp."),
    
    # filter observations before Katherine (LI Thanksgiving trip)
    spot_date >= as.Date("2023-11-01")
    
    ) |>
  
  # arrange by date seen (newest to oldest)
  arrange((desc(spot_date))) |>
  
  # keeps only the first occurrence of each unique species (based on current order of data)
  distinct(common_name, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  
  #slice_head(n = 25) |>
  select(name = common_name,
         sci_name = scientific_name,
         location,
         latitude,
         longitude,
         spot_date)


# Find my birds in eBird's taxonomy
ebirds <- taxonomy |>
  filter(comName %in% birds$name) |>
  select(name = comName,
         ebird_species_code = speciesCode,
         order,
         fam_common_name= familyComName,
         fam_sci_name = familySciName) |>
  
  mutate(ebird_url = paste0("https://ebird.org/species/", ebird_species_code),
         .before = 1)


marks_birds <- ebirds |>
  left_join(birds, by = "name") |>
  
  # arrange by `spot_date` (needs to happen before `gt`)
  arrange(desc(spot_date))


marks_birds |>
  leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles("OpenStreetMap") |>
  addMarkers(lng = ~longitude,
             lat = ~latitude,
             icon = makeIcon(iconUrl = "solid_bird.png",
                             iconWidth = 32,
                             iconHeight = 32,
                             iconAnchorX = 16,
                             iconAnchorY = 16),
             popup = paste0("<b>", marks_birds$name, "</b><br>",
                            "<i>", marks_birds$sci_name, "</i><br>",
                            marks_birds$location, "<br>",
                            format(marks_birds$spot_date, "%b %d, %Y"), "<br>",
                            "<a href='", marks_birds$ebird_url,
                            "' target='_blank'>View on eBird</a>"))


```

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

marks_birds |>
  
  select(ebird_url, sci_name, name, spot_date, latitude, longitude, location, fam_common_name) |>
  
  mutate(sci_name = gsub(" ", "<br>", sci_name),
         spot_date = gsub(" ", "<br>", format(spot_date, "%b %Y")),
         location_link = sprintf('<a href="https://www.google.com/maps?q=%s,%s" target="_blank">%s</a>',
                                 latitude, longitude, location)) |>

  gt() |>
  
  tab_options(column_labels.font.weight = "bold",  # column label weight
              column_labels.padding.horizontal = px(20),  # add space between column names
              data_row.padding.horizontal = px(20)) |>  # add space between cells
  
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "center",
                              v_align = "middle"),
            locations = cells_column_labels()) |>  # column labels
  
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left",
                              v_align = "middle"),
            locations = cells_column_labels(columns = ebird_url)) |>
  
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left",
                              style = "italic"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = sci_name)) |>  # cells
  
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "center"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = c(sci_name, spot_date, location_link, fam_common_name))) |>
  
  cols_label(ebird_url = "Name",
             sci_name = "Scientific Name",
             spot_date = "Date",
             location_link = "Location",
             fam_common_name = "Family") |>
  
  # ensure each `sci_name` is two lines
  fmt_markdown(columns = c(sci_name, spot_date, location_link)) |>
  
  fmt_url(columns = ebird_url,
          label = marks_birds$name,
          color = "blue") |>

  cols_hide(columns = c(latitude, longitude, location, name))

```
